notes: SR116 Maisons du Monde BE (BE/nl). Access route identical to bs116/cl116 (Tier1+Tier2 re-confirmed 403 DataDome, escalated to Claude-in-Chrome Tier 3, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow per prior pass). Main nav 'NIEUW' (New) dropdown has 4 entries: 2 are genuine /c/ product-listing pages, 2 are /edito/ editorial/marketing pages (excluded per brief - 'De nieuwste lente/zomer items zijn er!' -> /edito/deco-trends is a trend article, and 'De nieuwe tuincollectie is er!' -> /edito/tuin-collectie is a lookbook page, neither has a real product grid/count). The 2 genuine PLPs are seasonal and represent different, non-overlapping product sets (confirmed via distinct counts, distinct child-category breakdowns, and distinct titles), so both are kept as separate parent rows per the 'multiple PLPs for the same concept' rule: (1) 'Alle Lente-Zomer nieuwigheden van 2026' (All Spring-Summer 2026 novelties) - the current-season new arrivals, reached via the nav card 'All Spring-Summer novelties'; (2) 'Alle Herfst-Winter nieuwigheden' (All Autumn-Winter novelties) - reached via the nav card labelled 'New releases in preview' ('Nieuwigheden in voorpremiere'), i.e. an early/preview listing for the upcoming season. Each parent exposes genuine child listings via on-page category chips (verified as real distinct sub-PLPs with independent product counts via fresh full-page navigation + SSR-embedded HTML 'Je hebt 40 van de N producten bekeken' / 'N artikelen' text, not stale client-side counts). Spring-Summer 2026 children sum to 1231 vs parent 1420; Autumn-Winter children sum to 874 vs parent 967 - both consistent with overlap/uncategorized items, not an error. All qty values are exact site-reported counts.
